# Airbnb Scraper

The Apify actor [`tri_angle/airbnb-scraper`](https://apify.com/tri_angle/airbnb-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.102**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Airbnb rentals in your chosen destinations. Extract descriptions, locations, prices per night, ratings, reviews count, host details, amenities and more. Download scraped data in various formats including HTML, JSON and Excel.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Listing $0.004, Enriched Listing $0.006, Actor Start $0.0001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/tri_angle/airbnb-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/tri-angle-airbnb-scraper@0.0.102#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locationQueries` | array |  |  | Location Queries — List of location queries to scrape. Example: London, Manchester, Birmingham, etc. |
| `maxResults` | integer |  |  | Maximum results — Maximum results to return from this run |
| `startUrls` | array |  | `[]` | Start URLs — List of Airbnb URLs to start with. Note that you can only use search URLs here and not direct property URLs. For scraping direct property URLs, use the Airbnb Rooms URLs Scraper. Example start URL with search filters included: https://www.airbnb.com/s/Europe/homes?price_max=266&min_beds |
| `enrichUserProfiles` | boolean |  |  | Enrich User Profiles — If enabled, the actor makes extra requests for each host/co-host in every listing to get more detailed user info. This increases cost and runtime. If a profile is private or there's an unexpected error, it will be skipped and won't appear in the output. |
| `checkIn` | string |  |  | Check-In Date — Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format with zero-padded month and day, e.g., 2022-02-20. |
| `checkOut` | string |  |  | Check-Out Date — Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format with zero-padded month and day, e.g., 2022-02-20. |
| `locale` | string |  | `"en-US"` | Locale — Localized results in this locale will be extracted (language and region). |
| `priceMin` | integer |  |  | Minimum Price |
| `currency` | string |  | `"USD"` | Currency — Currency that will be extracted for prices. |
| `priceMax` | integer |  |  | Maximum Price |
| `minBeds` | integer |  |  | Minimum Beds |
| `minBedrooms` | integer |  |  | Minimum Bedrooms |
| `minBathrooms` | integer |  |  | Minimum Bathrooms |
| `adults` | integer |  |  | Adults |
| `children` | integer |  |  | Children |
| `infants` | integer |  |  | Infants |
| `pets` | integer |  |  | Pets |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
